exactQuestion: Why is LLY still routed as unresolved_material_contradiction after immutable Resolver evidence adjudicated the contradiction resolved and non-gating?
whyItMatters: A repeated resolved contradiction consumes Resolver capacity, creates false unresolved ownership, and risks liveness masquerading as progress.
lawfulFallbacks: Chief adjudicates the deterministic reconciliation consumer behavior without changing Methodology 1.0 or weakening any evidence gate.
Leave LLY Resolver work dormant until its routing input signature changes or Chief explicitly adjudicates.
successCondition: Deterministic reconciliation consumes the prior resolved/non-gating disposition, removes LLY unresolved_material_contradiction when no independent contradiction remains, preserves price-compression risk, and leaves Alpha-owned underwriting failures intact.

disposition.finding: The factual contradiction itself remains resolved. The remaining blocker is deterministic consumption/routing: the current queue still emits the same LLY contradiction after the prior immutable Resolver disposition directed reconciliation to clear it.
disposition.remainingRisk: Realized-price compression remains a material non-gating underwriting risk owned by Council Alpha.
disposition.directive: Chief: adjudicate the reconciliation consumer defect for LLY. Do not send the same unchanged contradiction back to Deep Resolver. Preserve the underlying price-compression evidence and all Alpha-owned score/provenance failures.

evidenceBasis.finding: Prior Resolver adjudication marked the volume/revenue versus realized-price compression tradeoff resolved and non-gating and directed deterministic reconciliation to consume it.
Fresh routing still places LLY rank 1 with unresolved_material_contradiction and repeats the same volume/revenue versus price-compression language.

antiRepeat.repeatedBlocker: Deterministic reconciliation did not consume the prior immutable resolved/non-gating LLY disposition.
antiRepeat.failedStrategy: Prior factual adjudication plus explicit deterministic-reconciliation directive did not change routing.
antiRepeat.changedStrategy: Do not re-adjudicate or reacquire evidence. Escalate the exact consumer decision to Chief and leave the unchanged item dormant until inputSignature/routing state changes.

learning.newLesson: A resolved Resolver disposition that is re-emitted unchanged is a reconciliation-consumer defect, not a new contradiction; after the second materially similar cycle it must become dormant and escalate to Chief.
